# find context stratigraphy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:findContextStratigraphy`](gmeow-findContextStratigraphy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/findContextStratigraphy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The stratigraphic unit or layer associated with a carrier's find context. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) (opaque reference) because general stratigraphic domain modeling is deferred to; this property provides the language-facing hook. Non-functional: competing stratigraphic interpretations coexist.
